description: Use when a user asks how much money will grow, e.g. "how much will $500 a month grow in 20 years?", "what will $10,000 be worth in 10 years at 7%?" or "how much interest will I earn?". Future value of a starting amount plus optional monthly contributions at a yearly rate, with total contributed and total interest. Compounding is monthly by default (annually, quarterly, semiannually or daily on request). Returns a plain-English explanation, the assumptions and the matching Compound Mint calculator page. Example: $10,000 at 7% for 10 years compounded annually = $19,671.51.

contribution_timing.description: Deposits at the end (default) or beginning of each month.

show_yearly.description: Include a year by year table.
